description: This file contains functions and type definitions related to managing provider configurations, secrets, and authentication methods within the openclaw project. It handles resolving API keys from environment variables, profiles, and config fallbacks, as well as normalizing and managing secret references.

methods.name: normalizeApiKeyConfig
methods.description: Normalizes an API key configuration string, extracting variable placeholders if present.

methods.name: toDiscoveryApiKey
methods.description: Converts a string value to a discovery API key, returning undefined if the value is non-secret.

methods.name: resolveEnvApiKeyVarName
methods.description: Resolves the environment variable name for an API key based on provider and environment.

methods.name: resolveAwsSdkApiKeyVarName
methods.description: Returns the environment variable name used for AWS SDK API keys, defaulting to 'AWS_PROFILE'.

methods.name: normalizeHeaderValues
methods.description: Normalizes header values in provider config, resolving secret references and marking headers for environment or non-environment sources.

methods.name: resolveApiKeyFromCredential
methods.description: Resolves an API key from a credential object, considering environment references and plaintext keys.

methods.name: resolveApiKeyFromProfiles
methods.description: Attempts to resolve an API key from stored profiles for a given provider.

methods.name: normalizeConfiguredProviderApiKey
methods.description: Normalizes the API key in provider config, replacing references with markers if needed.

methods.name: normalizeResolvedEnvApiKey
methods.description: Replaces an API key with an environment variable name if applicable.

methods.name: resolveMissingProviderApiKey
methods.description: Provides an API key for a provider if missing, using environment, profiles, or resolver functions.

methods.name: createProviderApiKeyResolver
methods.description: Creates a function to resolve API keys for providers based on environment, profiles, and config.

methods.name: createProviderAuthResolver
methods.description: Creates a function to resolve provider authentication methods, including OAuth, API keys, and config fallback.

methods.name: resolveConfigBackedProviderAuth
methods.description: Resolves provider authentication info from configuration, including fallback to plugin or XAI-specific logic.

methods.name: resolveXaiConfigFallbackAuth
methods.description: Resolves fallback authentication info for the 'xai' provider, including plugin-based API keys.
